describes: Muslim members of the Lok Sabha by general election, 1952-2024 (18 Lok Sabhas): muslim_seats, total_seats and the compilation cited per row.
compilation_note: Religion of MPs is not tabulated by the ECI or in PRS candidate-profile PDFs. Each row's count is cross-verified across at least two journalistic compilations (Maktoob Media, The India Forum / Hilal Ahmed historical series, FACTLY, Statista, ORF, Clarion India); the citing source is in the citation column. This committed, diffable table is the archived L1 the ls-share canonicaliser reads.
